About

Ryan Laird
Astrophysicist, science communicator and strategist

I'm an astrophysicist, science communicator and strategist working across space, sustainability and technology. I help organisations and individuals explain complex science clearly and accurately, through strategy, writing, teaching and mentoring.

I hold an MPhys in Astrophysics and am a Chartered Marketer (CMktr), a Member of the Institute of Physics and a Member of the Chartered Institute of Public Relations. I previously led marketing for ESA Business Applications through HE Space.

I'm Founder and Director of Green Orbit Digital, a specialist communications practice for space, sustainability and mission-led organisations, and I run Leicester Space Week. Beyond client work I write, publish research and build open-source tools.

MPhys (Hons) · MInstP · CMktr · MCIPR

How to work with me

Personal work and organisation-level work.

This is my personal site: a home for my writing, research, teaching, mentoring and individual perspective.

Green Orbit Digital is the separate practice I founded and direct for organisation-level communications, strategy and delivery. If you need a team to deliver a project, start atgreenorbit.space. If you want my own voice, expertise or time, start atWork with me.
